# dsh-restart-button
A draggable floating **restart button** for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web GUI.

Drag it where you want it, click it, confirm — the desktop app and its host process close and come
b

ack by themselves. If the restart cannot happen — a security suite blocks it, or the app simply
refu
ses to close — the button says so, cleans up after itself, and never leaves you with a spinner.
## Features

- **Draggable** — the button sits in the corner you drag it to; the position is stored in
`~/.dsh/re

start-button.json` and survives a restart.
- **Confirm, then watch** — a click opens a dialog. In th

e waiting state you can still cancel with
**取消重启**; after 45 seconds without the app closing, the pl

ugin cancels the job itself and tells
you why.
- **Custom icon** — four built-in vector glyphs, or u

pload your own image (PNG / JPG / WebP / GIF / SVG, ≤ 2 MB).
- **Custom background colour** — pick a

ny colour; the glyph switches between dark and light ink
automatically. Unset, it follows the UI the

me.
- **Lockable position** — freeze the button in place so a stray drag cannot move it.
- Everythin
g is editable in **Settings → Restart button** and applies immediately.

Through the plugin manager: open **插件 / Plugins → 安装插件** and paste the package URL below.

minal, in the profile you use:

The host half mounts on the next app start; the browser half after the page reloads.
## How the restart works
`POST /api/restart-button/restart` starts `lib/relauncher.mjs` as a detached process **on the app's

own executable** (`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`), so no PowerShell and no scheduled task is involved —
thos
e are exactly what Windows security suites block. The launcher:

1. waits 0.3 s, and gives up harmlessly if the UI cancelled in the meantime;
2. asks the app to clos

e once (`taskkill /im`), then escalates to a forced kill every 150 ms until no
app process is left —

**and refuses to start a second instance** if they survive;
3. starts the app again, retrying throu

gh `cmd start` and PowerShell when the direct spawn is refused,
and reports `relaunched` as soon as

the new process exists.
The whole cycle is a few seconds; the app's own window then takes a moment t

rocess exists.
The whole cycle is a few seconds; the app's own window then takes a moment to appear.
The host verifies the launcher really started (its first log line) within 1.8 s, so a blocked script
becomes an error dialog instead of a silent no-op. Cancel and status are separate endpoints, and a
45-second watchdog ends a restart that never takes effect.

Logs land in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-restart-button\relaunch.log`; the last lines are also served by
`GE
T /api/restart-button/log`.
An in-flight answer is interrupted by the restart; the saved session transcript is not.
## Troubleshooting
| What you see | What it means |
| *启动器没有跑起来（多半被 360 / 火绒 之类的安全软件拦下了）* | The launcher process could not start or died immediately. Ad

d the DeepSeek Harness folder to the security software's allowlist and retry. |
| *重启超过 45 秒没有生效，已自动
终止* | Nothing closed within the watchdog. The app is untouched; check the log for the launcher's exi

t codes. |
| *已经发出关闭指令，这次重启无法取消* | The close request is already out; the launcher finishes the cycle

so the app cannot be left closed. |
| *the app survived the forced close — not starting a second in
stance* | The force close was blocked. Nothing was started twice; quit the app by hand and reopen it
nce* | The force close was blocked. Nothing was started twice; quit the app by hand and reopen it. |
## If the app closes but does not come back
The launcher only closes the app after it has proven it can run, and it retries the start three ways
(app binary → `cmd start` → PowerShell `Start-Process`). If all three are refused, the log names ea

ch
failure and the app stays closed — on those machines Windows security software is blocking proces

s
creation by an unsigned script host.
Add both executables to the allowlist of every security suite you run, then try again:
| Suite | Where |

| 360 安全卫士 | 安全防护中心 → 信任区 → 添加目录，加入 `D:\deep seek`（至少 `DeepSeek Harness.exe` 与 `node.exe`） |
| 火绒安全软
件 | 防护中心 → 信任区 → 添加文件/目录，加入 `DeepSeek Harness.exe` 和 `…\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\…\dependencies\node\bin\no

de.exe` |
| Windows Defender | 病毒和威胁防护 → 管理设置 → 排除项 → 添加文件夹 `D:\deep seek` |

Quitting 360 / 火绒 for the duration of a restart also works, but the allowlist is what makes the
butt

火绒 for the duration of a restart also works, but the allowlist is what makes the
button dependable.
The log is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-restart-button\relaunch.log`; it is rewritten on every attempt, so re

ad
it before clicking again. `GET /api/restart-button/log` returns the same lines.

| Field | Effect |

| Icon | four built-in glyphs, or an uploaded image stored in `~/.dsh/restart-button/icon.*` |
| Bac

kground | any colour, or *follow theme* (the default) |
| Lock position | stops dragging, keeps the

| any colour, or *follow theme* (the default) |
| Lock position | stops dragging, keeps the click |
## API
| Method | Path | Purpose |

| GET / POST | `/api/restart-button/config` | read / merge the configuration |
| GET / POST | `/api/

restart-button/icon` | the uploaded icon / upload it as `{"dataUrl":"data:image/png;base64,…"}` |
|
POST | `/api/restart-button/restart` | start a restart; `{"dryRun":true}` only resolves the paths |
| GET | `/api/restart-button/status` | job phase: `starting`, `launched`, `done`, `cancelled`, `time

out`, `blocked`, `failed`, `irreversible` |

## Requirements

- dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.1, Windows (the relauncher uses `taskkill` and the app's own binary).
- React 18 i
s provided by the host.
